set.body: Slice of g2-archive-scaling. Hash the complete canonical geometry/context/provenance prefix once per distinct prefix during an archive encode, then fork independent SHA states for per-map cells. Existing digests, wire documents and typed refusals must remain identical on JVM and Scala.js. Add boundary tests for independent SHA-state copies and direct canonical-document compatibility, and measure the realistic explicit-selector workload.
set.title: Reuse canonical density context hashing without changing saved identities
